answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence endures only through sustained honest service; brief activity cannot bank durable trust. In an EigenTrust-style matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has negligible incoming endorsement and near-zero eigenvector centrality. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed trust, so even a harbor of colluding onyx identities cannot reach the summit of consensus without credible, repeated interactions.
